findings.rule: Constitution I.1, #296 (an answer without detail must not borrow requirement wording; only the named skill in general terms), mandate (1)
findings.trigger: JD line '- Experience presenting quarterly results to the board for 3+ years' through OfflineJobDescriptionAnalyzer gives fallback keywords [presenting, quarterly, results] (RequirementExtractor.kt:38-43, the first 3 words of the requirement). Answer A_FEW_TIMES with empty detail makes fact ans-req-1 = 'presenting, quarterly, results'. Summary 'Presenting quarterly results.' citing ans-req-1 is kept with zero violations, and the skills line ['SQL','Quarterly','Results'] is kept with zero violations. The candidate only said 'a few times'; 'quarterly' is a requirement specific. Probe run on a copy of the head confirmed both.
findings.title: Fallback requirement keywords copy JD wording into the answer fact and the skills allowlist
findings.proof: TailorResumeUseCaseTest: analyse the JD line above, answer A_FEW_TIMES with detail '', propose summary 'Presenting quarterly results.' citing ans-<req>; expect violations non-empty and text == profile.summary (currently passes through unchanged). Fix sketch: when the detail is blank, take only keywords that isNamedSkillKeyword (KeywordsStatedIn.kt:20) accepts; this changes the #269/#270 shared contract, so the lead decides for both lanes.

findings.rule: Constitution I.1, D36 and D23 (split clauses at ', ', and, or, with; each clause from ONE cited fact; at least one content word), mandate (1)
findings.trigger: Answer YES_REGULARLY, detail 'Presented the monthly variance report to the CFO'; profile bullet exp-infosys-b1 'Built Power BI dashboards for monthly finance reports'. Summary 'Presented the monthly variance report to the CFO with Power BI dashboards.' citing [exp-infosys-b1, ans-req-1] is kept with zero violations (probe confirmed). Neither fact says the CFO report used Power BI. The sentence is split only at [.!?] and guard.check gets every cited source together, and TokenSubset/NumberClaims/term checks take the union of the source texts.
findings.title: Summary check lets words from two cited facts recombine into one claim
findings.proof: TailorResumeUseCaseTest: the summary and sources above; expect violations non-empty and text == profile.summary. Fix sketch: split clauses as D36 says and pass each clause if guard.check(clause, listOf(source), profile) is empty for at least one single cited source; reject a summary with no content word.

findings.rule: Constitution I.2 and D4 (per-change Undo plus one Accept changes action), criterion 270-c6
findings.trigger: Tailoring returns a supported summary (decision PENDING, counted in changeCount). The user wants to keep the original summary. UpdateBulletDecisionUseCase matches only bullets by id (UpdateBulletDecisionUseCase.kt:26), so no call can set the summary or skills to REJECTED. ExportReadiness returns PENDING_CHANGES until AcceptChangesUseCase runs, and that sets the summary to ACCEPTED. Export therefore requires accepting a summary or skills change the user tried to undo.
findings.title: Summary and skills changes have no Undo, so export forces their acceptance
findings.proof: UpdateBulletDecisionUseCaseTest: application with a PENDING summary; any invocation leaves summary.decision PENDING, and ExportReadiness.check stays PENDING_CHANGES until AcceptChangesUseCase marks it ACCEPTED. Fix sketch: give the summary and skills a decision target (for example fixed ids 'summary' and 'skills') in UpdateBulletDecisionUseCase.

findings.rule: Cross-lane shared contract (scout constraint C8: choices map to the #268 quickAnswer choice)
findings.trigger: QuickAnswer.choice is a free String. #268 PrototypeFixtures.kt:62, ApplicationRepositoryContractTest.kt:126 and AccountDataArchiveWriterSimplifiedFlowTest store choice 'yes'. AnswerFacts accepts only the exact strings 'YES_REGULARLY' and 'A_FEW_TIMES', so the prototype answer creates no fact and no keywords. This fails closed (no truth risk), but the prototype's answer can never back a change.
findings.title: Answer choice constants do not match the 'yes' value stored by #268 fixtures
findings.proof: AnswerFacts.factOf(QuickAnswer(req.id, "yes", "detail"), job) returns null. Fix sketch: one shared choice enum or constants in core:model that both #268 data and #269/#270 use.

findings.rule: Constitution I.2 (nothing exported that the user did not accept); TOCTOU
findings.trigger: The user taps Undo on bullet b1, then Accept changes, quickly. Both coroutines read the same snapshot through observeApplication().first(). Undo upserts b1=REJECTED. Accept then upserts the whole application with b1=ACCEPTED from its stale read. BulletReconciler exports b1's proposed text. This is latent until W4-C2 wires both actions, and UpdateBulletDecisionUseCase has the same read-modify-write.
findings.title: Accept changes can overwrite a concurrent Undo with ACCEPTED
findings.proof: With a repository fake that suspends inside first(), run UpdateBulletDecisionUseCase(REJECTED) and AcceptChangesUseCase concurrently; expect b1 REJECTED, but it ends up ACCEPTED. Fix sketch: serialise decision writes (one Mutex shared by both use cases, or a repository transaction that updates decisions in place).
